description: This file implements the Archive class and related functions for handling archive files, including listing contents, extracting files, and extracting to memory, using the bsdtar utility.

classes.name: Archive
classes.description: A class for handling archive files, providing methods to list contents, extract files, and extract to memory.

methods.name: Archive::Archive
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the archive with a file path.

methods.name: Archive::Contents
methods.description: Returns a list of the contents of the archive.

methods.name: Archive::ExtractAll
methods.description: Extracts all files from the archive to the specified directory.

methods.name: Archive::ExtractFiles
methods.description: Extracts specified files from the archive to the target directory.

methods.name: Archive::ExtractToMemory
methods.description: Extracts a specific file from the archive into memory as a string.
